newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa details capitalisation share award.
newsitem.headline: Absa details capitalisation share award.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd said on Monday the number of capitalisation shares shareholders will become entitled to will be in the ratio that 27 cents bears to the issue price discounted by a factor of six percent.
The issue price is defined as the average closing price of Absa's shares on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange for the four days ending January 9. Absa said the minimum issue price will be 21.15 rand.
In order to qualify for the award, shareholders must be registered on December 13. Shareholders have the option of instead receiving an interim cash divided of 27 cents a share.
